scope.name: Persistent Designs & Collections
in_scope: persist Fashion Design Engine semantic garment designs through existing local document/storage authority so designs survive Studio/session reloads
provide a My Designs library with deterministic reopen, duplicate/variant and version-history workflows over FGA-PARAM-1 garment state
support bounded named collections of saved garment designs without introducing ownership, commerce or public-sharing authority
preserve topology template, fit diagnostics, preview view and design provenance needed to reopen a design safely in the live Studio
provide governed provider-off export and reviewed import of semantic design records without silently accepting invalid or incompatible garment state
focused cross-platform persistence/reopen/version/collection/import-export tests including stale or invalid record rejection
out_of_scope: FDE-06 PAPT asset realization, generative asset synthesis or paid production execution
cloud collaboration or public design sharing
Oaran fashion houses, designers, eras or cultural style catalogs
Mall, marketplace, storefronts, commerce or creator monetization
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
